claims.claim: perf provides Linux performance counters and profiling/tracing facilities for CPU and software events.
claims.kind: kernel behavior, API or project documentation
claims.notes: Event availability depends on CPU, kernel and permissions.

claims.claim: Flame graphs visualize aggregated stack samples; wide frames indicate more sampled activity, not necessarily exclusive wall-clock time.
claims.kind: kernel behavior, API or project documentation
claims.notes: Interpretation depends on sampling mode and stack collection.

claims.claim: fio is a flexible I/O workload generator and benchmark tool.
claims.kind: kernel behavior, API or project documentation
claims.notes: Results require workload, hardware and configuration context.

claims.claim: kmemleak reports possible orphaned allocations and is a debugging aid rather than a proof of a memory leak.
claims.kind: kernel behavior, API or project documentation
claims.notes: False positives and untracked allocation paths are possible.
